LanguageData.Plant_TreeCocoa.label: cocoa tree
LanguageData.Plant_TreeCocoa.description: A cocoa tree. Its beans are used in making chocolate. Yields beans twice a year. Only grown in tropical regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantAppletree.label: apple tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantAppletree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows large, juicy red apples. Bears fruit five times a year once mature. Does best in temperate climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantBananaTree.label: banana tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantBananaTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows numerous clusters of bananas. Bears fruit three times a year once it matures. Only grown in the tropics.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantBreadfruitTree.label: breadfruit tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantBreadfruitTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows a number of breadfruits. Bears fruit five times a year once mature. Breadfruit is often a staple food in tropical regions. Only found in rainforests.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantCherryTree.label: cherry tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantCherryTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows cherries. Bears fruit less than two times a year once mature. Does best in temperate regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantCoconutTree.label: coconut tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantCoconutTree.description: A fruit bearing palm tree that grows coconuts. Bears fruit three times a year. Only grows well in tropical regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantDurianTree.label: durian tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantDurianTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows a number of durians. Bears fruit two times a year once mature. Only grows in tropical regions.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantFigTree.label: fig tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantFigTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows a number of fig pods. Bears fruit four times a year once mature. Only grows well in arid climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantOrangeTree.label: citrus tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantOrangeTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows a number of orange citrus fruit. Bears fruit four times a year once it matures. Only likes warmer climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPeachTree.label: peach tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPeachTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows large, juicy peaches. Bears fruit two times a year once mature. Does best in temperate climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPecanTree.label: pecan tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPecanTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows small pods that house pecans within them. Bears fruit less than two times a year. Found primarily in temperate climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPlumTree.label: plum tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPlumTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows large, juicy plums. Bears fruit three times a year once mature. Likes temperate and tropical climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPomegranateTree.label: pomegranate tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantPomegranateTree.description: A fruit bearing tree that grows a number of pomegranates. Bears fruit twice a year once mature. Likes hot, dry climates.
LanguageData.RC2_PlantSugarMapleTree.label: sugar maple tree
LanguageData.RC2_PlantSugarMapleTree.description: A common medium-sized tree, easily identifiable by its distinct three-pointed leaf. This particular breed of tree has a higher sugar content, perfect for syrup production - it produces three bottles worth of syrup a year. Found in colder and temperate climates.
